Instagram Post Preview

See your photo and caption as a realistic square Instagram post mock.

Preview

📖 How to use

  1. Upload a photo or paste an image URL.
  2. Type your caption with hashtags.
  3. Add your username.
  4. Render the realistic IG post mock.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the preview work?

Upload an image or paste an image URL, type your caption, and the tool renders an Instagram-style square post mock.

Does it post to Instagram?

No — this is a visual mock only. Screenshot it or copy the caption to use in the Instagram app.

Why is my image cropped square?

Instagram crops feed photos to square (1:1) by default — the preview uses that crop with object-fit cover.

Can I upload a photo or use a URL?

Yes — both an upload and a URL are supported; uploads stay in your browser.
